name: Fribourg
flagName: Flag of the Canton of Fribourg
summary: A square of black over white. Fribourg joined the Confederacy in 1481 and lies on the border between French and German-speaking Switzerland.
origin: The black and white arms are recorded from the 15th century. Fribourg joined the Confederacy at the Diet of Stans in 1481.
facts: Fribourg is bilingual, French and German.
Solothurn, which joined the same year, has red over white.
clues: A bilingual canton that joined in 1481.
